en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Коски до рамена' is literally 'bones to the shoulders' (my reading: skeletal remains or a grim image). 'Ми' in verbs is a narrative filler.

lines.cyr: ми го затвориле во темни зандани.
lines.lat: mi go zatvorile vo temni zandani.
lines.en: they imprisoned him in dark dungeons.

lines.cyr: Во зандани има вода до колена,
lines.lat: Vo zandani ima voda do kolena,
lines.en: In the dungeons there is water to the knees,

lines.cyr: вода до колена, коски до рамена.
lines.lat: voda do kolena, koski do ramena.
lines.en: water to the knees, bones to the shoulders.

lines.cyr: Лежал што ми лежал, време три години,
lines.lat: Ležal što mi ležal, vreme tri godini,
lines.en: He lay and lay, the time of three years,

lines.cyr: време три години, а и шест месеци.
lines.lat: vreme tri godini, a i šest meseci.
lines.en: the time of three years and six months.

lines.cyr: Кога време дојде Јордан да се пушта,
lines.lat: Koga vreme dojde Jordan da se pušta,
lines.en: When the time came for Jordan to be released,

lines.cyr: право тој ми трга во негово село.
lines.lat: pravo toj mi trga vo negovo selo.
lines.en: straight he set out for his village.

lines.cyr: Кога ми пристигнал в' неговата куќа,
lines.lat: Koga mi pristignal v' negovata kuḱa,
lines.en: When he arrived at his house,

lines.cyr: два пати ми викнал, три пати ми тропнал.
lines.lat: dva pati mi viknal, tri pati mi tropnal.
lines.en: twice he called, three times he knocked.
opened the gate, embraced her son.

lines.cyr: - Каде ми е мајко мојто верно либе
lines.lat: - Kade mi e majko mojto verno libe
lines.en: - Where is, mother, my faithful sweetheart,

lines.cyr: порти да отвори, мене да пречека?
lines.lat: porti da otvori, mene da prečeka?
lines.en: to open the gate, to meet me?

lines.cyr: - Твојто верно либе, сношти се омажи
lines.lat: - Tvojto verno libe, snošti se omaži
lines.en: - Your faithful sweetheart married last night

lines.cyr: за твојот комшија, за твојот побратим.
lines.lat: za tvojot komšija, za tvojot pobratim.
lines.en: to your neighbor, to your sworn brother.
